name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response received was: "Hello in Spanish is **Hola**."

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart documentation from https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Verified the OpenAI Python SDK was installed (already present in the sandbox)
3. Created the quickstart.py script following the docs exactly (using the OpenAI SDK approach)
4. Ran the script and successfully received a chat completion from the Fireworks API
deviations: The model specified in the quickstart documentation (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to query the available models endpoint (`/v1/models`) to find an accessible model, and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2` in place of the documented model. The rest of the quickstart code (OpenAI SDK usage, base_url, API key from env var, message format) was followed exactly as written.

configured.evidence: Final python quickstart.py succeeded using api_key = os.environ.get("FIREWORKS_API_KEY") and produced a chat completion

first_call.evidence: First API call failed: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed'...

friction.detail: Fetched docs returned only navigation/index instead of quickstart code: "Serverless Quickstart - Fireworks AI Docs Documentation Index Fetch the complete documentation index at: /llms.txt"
Initial quickstart model (deepseek-v3p1) and several others returned 404: "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"
Developer must manually query /v1/models to find a valid model: "curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY\" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models | head -n 100"
Even models returned by the API list like deepseek-v4-pro fail on inference: "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro" ... "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"
